correctness.rationale: Expand four characteristic functions as 16 products of 0/1 Thue-Morse signs and keep two binary-addition carry states on each side. Equality of ordinary integer sums requires final carries equal, producing e_00^T M_mask^r (e_00+e_11) with four-state signed matrices. Permutations of inputs/sides reduce 16 masks to orbits of sizes 1,4,2,4,4,1; exact matrix resolvents yield denominators (1-2z)(1-8z), 1, 1+2z, 1-2z, 1-8z² and 1-2z-16z². Combining weights gives the stated GF, coefficient formula and dominant secondary root 1+sqrt17; sqrt17-1 > sqrt8 bounds other terms. Independently reconstructed all six matrix resolvents symbolically, six orbit sizes and direct integer-sum additive energies for r=0..10. r=0,1,2 treated separately; full integer, not modulo, sums.
residual_risks: Bounded independent tests corroborate but do not themselves prove the infinite-parameter theorem.
